cases.grammatical_function: marks the subject of a sentence, predicate of nominal sentence, and names of kana/inna sisters
cases.semantic_projection: typically marks the entity performing or being described; the pivot of the predication
cases.certainty_effect: high — nominative is the default state of stability in Arabic sentence structure

cases.grammatical_function: marks direct objects, circumstantial qualifiers, specifiers, exceptions, and predicates of kana
cases.semantic_projection: marks the entity affected, the manner, the cause, the time/place as adverbial, or the specification
cases.certainty_effect: medium-high — accusative is strongly governed but has many syntactic roles

cases.grammatical_function: marks nouns governed by prepositions or in construct state (idafa)
cases.semantic_projection: marks possession, attribution, location, manner, and various relational meanings encoded by prepositions
cases.certainty_effect: high — genitive is strongly governed by explicit prepositions or idafa structure

cases.grammatical_function: applies to imperfect verbs; marks negation (lam), prohibition (la), and conditional clauses
cases.semantic_projection: marks modal contexts: negation of past, prohibition, or conditionality
cases.certainty_effect: high — jussive is always triggered by explicit governing particles or conditionals

cases.grammatical_function: indeclinable words that occupy a syntactic position; case is local (محل) not surface
cases.semantic_projection: the word form does not change but its syntactic role is tracked relationally
cases.certainty_effect: medium — local case requires structural inference

cases.grammatical_function: case that cannot be phonetically realized due to alif maqsura, ya, or pronominal suffix
cases.semantic_projection: same as the underlying case but hidden by phonological constraints
cases.certainty_effect: medium — estimated cases require lexical knowledge of word type
